notes.title: Developer Log #1, Work in Progress
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

First of all, we would like to thank everyone who has bought this game. Thank you so much for your support.

We apologize for not providing any information yet regarding further game development for a while. But don't worry, the development is still being worked on, not stopped or abandoned.

Indeed, there have been a lot of changes to the game framework and its mechanics. So, at this point, we would like to give you some information about what are currently work in progress:

[h3]1. Defense Mission[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/50e177531ef6533b65ebb3f994bd032d8070b0db.png[/img]

The Defense Mission mechanism is developed by adding a lot of Tower Defense mechanics & elements and adjusted to make it a little unique to this game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/bdc65368ecccb5f150eb6f15d9eaf3238c9ddc8e.png[/img]

It becomes one of the main features as a mechanism to hold and kill enemies who will try to break through and destroy the entrance to the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/3416e08384bfa961b4ee79104ebf124d3a0d96ca.png[/img]

Along with the Third Person Shooter Perspective, you have option to change the view to a top-down view anytime during the Defense Mission. However, you cannot change/add/replace anything while in top-down view mode. If you want to change / add / replace, you have to return to third person (Alicia) view mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/bda511140f41c5e1e9a40521f2348f95932f6cdf.png[/img]

I will explain more detail about the major improvement of Defense Mission later, including all 8 Front Guard Unit types (with their own unique abilities). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/c719b014e933c0568e73aec2733526c1d800c2f1.png[/img]

Front Guard Units can be upgraded up to level 3.


[h3]2. Extraction Mission[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/5328472eb7d59136c4411a3a98193e9aa8ce3a98.png[/img]

This mission is simple, enter the area, take the mission item, then get out of there. However, carrying out this mission may not be easy because there will be many enemies there ready to attack and chase Alicia. Not to mention the incoming waves of enemies that can prevent Alicia from getting out of there safely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791543/157d73879ebc7608cb7880c5b900b98c09dbc131.png[/img]

I will provide more information about this Extraction Mission later in the next Dev Log.

[h3]3. Kill Mission[/h3]
If you've ever fought a boss in the current Make It In Time game version, this is the same bosses, but they are not main mission. This is side mission where it is only optional, and you can still finish this game without taking any of kill missions.

Even though it's a side mission, doing this mission is not easy, because your action skills and endurance will be tested. If you like a challenge, try to do this mission.

There will be more screen shots of this in next dev log.


[h3]4. Menu Based for Activity & Interaction: [/h3]
I cannot say further yet about this. More will be explained later.


[h3]5. Femonoid Shop:[/h3]
The Femonoid Shop will sell more weapons and items every time you complete the main mission.


[h3]6. Steam Achievements:[/h3]
Several Steam Achievements will be added.


[h3]7. Controller Support:[/h3]
Partial Controller support will be added if possible, along with this major overhaul update.


[h3]8. Play the game until finished:[/h3]
After the next major overhaul update, you will be able to finish the game.


We don't have any ETA yet, but we would like to aim in 2023 June, if everything goes well. 
We will inform you the progress with more details in next month's dev log, as well as show more screen shots.

If you have any questions, suggestions or critics, feel free to let us know on the Steam Forum or chat us in our [url=https://discord.gg/mx8et4gX6C]Discord here[/url].


Thank you so much for your consideration and support.

Best Regards,
-- Kruntazie Games --

notes.title: Small Patch v0.2.1 - Bugs Fixes & About Dynamic Combat Music
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have fixed several bugs as below:

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on Dynamic Combat Music logic.
[*] Fixed some text in Equip Weapon pop up hint in Prologue Chapter.
[*] Fixed a bug on scene when Alicia took a machete, save game and exit without finish the quest.
[*] Fixed a bug, Boss HP UI didn't hide when open Game Menu (when fighting Boss).
[*] Removed the "I" button referenced to open Inventory. So, opening Inventory must be done through Game Menu
[*] Fixed a bug, selected Graphic Settings sometimes not display correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug, Fast Travel didn't reset monster spawn points properly. 
[/list]
[h3]About Dynamic Combat Music: [/h3]
When you hear the Combat Music plays, it means that you have been seen and chased by enemies and you are in Combat State. And when in Combat State, you can't Save Game, can't use Fast Travel, and can't access Loadout & Inventory. 

The update patch should be run automatically before you start the game.

Thank you so much for your support.

Best Regards,
-- Kruntazie Games --

notes.title: Small Patch - Bugs Fixes & Some Improvement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have fixed some bugs and made some improvement as below:

[h3][b]Bugs Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Periodic Stuttering / Periodic Small Freezes in Gameplay.
[*] Fixed a few bugs in Monster Spawned logic.
[*] Fixed a bug, EXP not acquired when some enemies killed by grenade explosion.
[*] Fixed a bug, Medical Item Effect Rate stat not calculated properly when using medical item.
[/list]
[h3][b]Some Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added How to Save Game to pop up hint in Prologue Chapter.
[*] Improve some pop up hint's text and button reference in Prologue Chapter.
[*] Added Use Item visual effect & healing value.
[*] Improve some gameplay performance.
[/list]
About how to save game, if you don't know yet, here it is: 
- When you near a checkpoint device, open game menu and choose save game. Save game only available when you are near a checkpoint device, you aren't in combat and not doing important events such as Defense Mission.

The updated patch should be run automatically before you start the game.

Thank you so much for your support.

Best Regards,
-- Kruntazie Games --

notes.title: Free Early Purchase DLC (Limited Time)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We would like to announce a new Early Purchase DLC, which is FREE for a limited time. The Early Purchase DLC contains 3 powerful E-Slot Level 5 Items, and they can't be acquired in game. 

The 3 E-Slot Items are : 
- Super Speed Bullet E-Slot Level 5 (add 22% bullet damage rate)
- Super Strong Bullet E-Slot Level 5 (add 25% critical rate)
- Super Lucky Coin E-Slot Level 5 (add 50% earn coin rate)

The Early Purchase DLC will be released on the same date as Make It In Time game, so you can have 3 Super E-Slot Items from the start of game. 

Please note that, this free offer is available only during the promotional time of Make It In Time game release. After that, the DLC items will be available again at a later date.

Let us know if you have any question or concern.

Thank you so much for your support.

[b]EDIT:
The Promotional Period is over, and this free DLC is no longer available for new users.
[/b]

Best Regards,
-- Kruntazie Games --
